content.test_md_blob:
# Web: block add to cart when a required product option is missing

> Prove that add to cart is blocked until required options are selected and that the shopper is told which required option is missing.

## Step 1

At {{start_url}}, open a product listing that contains {{product_with_required_options}} and open {{product_with_required_options}} from that listing.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-10, ac-11

On the product detail page for {{product_with_required_options}}, leave one required option unselected and attempt to add the product to the cart, then assert the page identifies the specific missing required option and no successful add-to-cart completion is shown.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: At {{start_url}}, open a product listing that contains {{product_with_required_options}} and open {{product_with_required_options}} from that listing.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: forbidden-presence
      operand: successful add-to-cart completion before all required options are selected
      operator: exists
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-10
    objective: On the product detail page for {{product_with_required_options}}, leave one required option unselected and attempt to add the product to the cart, then assert the page identifies the specific missing required option and no successful add-to-cart completion is shown.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-10
      - ac-11
scenario: Attempt to add a product while a required option is still missing
title: 'Web: block add to cart when a required product option is missing'
